verdict.rationale: Buzz's own materials claim unified search across conversations, patches, workflow runs and approvals, and say agents can search six months of history, so message-history search is a first-party capability. Nothing documents search filters or admin-level search, and 'six months' suggests the history may not be complete. Missing for 10: documented filters by sender, channel and date; evidence of full (unbounded) history search; admin-scoped search UI/CLI docs; hands-on corroboration.
